correctness.rationale: Exact diagonal equivalence to the Frobenius companion proves strong linearization, and det(S)=-eQ. All positive coefficients force eta_Q=1 for positive t. The limiting rank-two matrix has nonzero singular-product 1 and norm phi; determinant asymptotics give least pencil residual t/(phi U). First-order left/right singular equations determine BOTH selected coordinates. Restricted Gram traces/determinants yield exact attainable vanishing thresholds with stated constants; symbolic algebra and independent numerical SVD confirm needed identities. No finite test is substituted for a universal proof.

value.rationale: Quantifies a gap explicitly identified as unresolved in the motivating 2026 pencil construction: a residual-only test can report arbitrarily small unstructured pencil error while coefficientwise polynomial error is maximal. Both left and right extraction channels lose order U, and exact two-sided zero-block thresholds give nontrivial concrete safety calibration. This is a mathematical barrier for designing acceptance tests, not merely a normalization check or arbitrary singular value calculation.
